content.text: Giving Day is today! Show your support for Lynn University with a cause that speaks to you! Giving Day 2026! Donate today Search lynn.edu Degree programsCost & aidApply nowVisit This is where it all begins ... the future starts now You're ready for your next chapter, and we can't wait to help you write it. At Lynn, we're consistently recognized as a top-ranking institution for our commitment to a personalized college experience. With our small class sizes and accelerated degrees, you'll learn from professors ready to help you achieve your goals. It's where you'll meet new friends, learn about other cultures and immerse yourself in new ways of life. From state-of-the-art living spaces to award-winning food, you'll experience the comforts of home, away from home. Explore campus life 6 colleges, 100+ programs endless possibilities We have an innovative approach to education. Our curriculum provides students with hands-on experiences, so you're not just sitting in a classroom; you're discovering your passions. Check out our academic majors, and you'll see that there’s something for everyone. Learn more about tuition and aid Student ambassadors Approximately 3,500 students from over 100 countries and nearly all 50 states. You'll want to know them. I chose Lynn because they have a great pilot program, and it has an amazing student community. Outside of class, I enjoy meeting new people around campus, exploring South Florida and going plane spotting in Miami. After my four great years at Lynn, I hope to accomplish my dream of becoming an airline pilot. Jorge Suarez La Torre '27Guayama, Puerto Rico, Social Impact and Entrepreneurship jsuarezlatorrepsw@lynn.edu I chose Lynn because of its accelerated aviation program, diversity and career opportunities. Outside of the classroom, I enjoy taking photos and videos, and working in the office of admissions as a content creator. After graduation, I am planning to grow the aviation industry in Central Asia. Oybek Jurabaev '26Samarkand, Uzbekistan, Aviation Management ojurabaevpsw@lynn.edu I chose Lynn because the moment I first came to visit, I loved the sense of community here. Everyone is welcoming, and I felt like I belonged right away. I like to go to the beach, read, listen to music, and do pilates outside of class. After Lynn, I hope to be able to work in the fashion industry in fashion show production and fashion styling, always following the values and lessons that Lynn taught me. Luciana Lovato '29Quito, Ecuador, Fashion and Retail llovatopsw@lynn.edu Our student ambassadors meet with prospective students and families, answer questions about Lynn and lead campus tours. Thanks to the generosity of our donors, more than 220 students received financial support this year, as endowments increased and opened doors to the personalized, global education that defines the Lynn experience. From 2024–2025, Lynn added nine new endowed scholarships, bringing the total to 92 endowments—of these, 70 support students through scholarships.With Giving Day just two days away, you can be part of that impact.
